+Default value of ``FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS`` set to 0o644
+-----------------------------------------------------------
+
+The :setting:`FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS` setting now defaults to ``0o644``
+instead of ``None``. Files uploaded through Django's file storage API used
+to end up with different permissions, depending on the size of the uploaded
+file and the upload handler being used, and this new default avoids that
+inconsistency. If you want the old behavior, set ``FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS``
+to ``None`` in your settings.
+
